stories.title: Israelis mark three years since October 7 attack
stories.summary: Israelis gathered in silence at Kibbutz Kfar Aza and other communities near the Gaza border to mark three years since the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attack, with ceremonies and protests planned at more than 400 locations. The anniversary comes as ceasefire and hostage negotiations remain fragile.

stories.title: Trump rallies Nebraska voters ahead of midterms
stories.summary: President Trump held a rally in Nebraska with Republican candidates including gubernatorial hopeful Pete Ricketts, part of a push to energize GOP voters before the November midterm elections. Nebraska is among the states where control of Congress could be decided.

stories.title: Aid crisis deepens in South Sudan as food stocks run low
stories.summary: Funding shortages are threatening food and nutrition assistance for hundreds of thousands of refugees and asylum seekers in South Sudan, where families who fled the war in neighboring Sudan crowd transit sites such as Renk. Aid agencies warn stocks are running low.

stories.title: Israel marks October 7 anniversary with day of ceremonies
stories.summary: Commemorations began at 6:29 a.m. local time and continue with a main evening ceremony in Tel Aviv, three years after the attack that triggered the Gaza war. Families of victims and of hostages led tributes across the country.

stories.title: Spotify expands audiobooks to over 180 markets
stories.summary: Spotify said its audiobook catalogue is now available in more than 180 markets, a major expansion of a business it has been pushing as a growth driver beyond music and podcasts. The move steps up competition with Audible and other audiobook platforms.

stories.title: Hackers obtain counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other services
stories.summary: Attackers obtained counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large services, a compromise that undermines the trust model behind HTTPS encryption. Security researchers are pressing certificate authorities and browser makers to tighten issuance checks.

stories.title: OpenAI model produces hundreds of mathematical results
stories.summary: OpenAI published 722 manuscripts covering 372 result families generated by an unreleased internal model, claiming progress on long-open problems including a zero-free region for the zeta function and the Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties. The work is on GitHub with Lean formalizations, but none of it has been peer reviewed.

stories.title: South Korea says AI agents likely used in bank hacks
stories.summary: South Korean President Lee said AI agents appear to have been used to breach banking systems in South Korea, prompting government scrutiny of autonomous hacking tools. Regulators are weighing tighter security requirements for financial institutions.

stories.title: Three keys for the Browns to make it four straight wins
stories.summary: Cleveland takes a 3-1 record and a three-game win streak into the game at the New York Jets, where pressuring Geno Smith and avoiding turnovers are seen as the deciding factors. A win would match the best five-game start of the Todd Monken era.

stories.title: Pluto: Monken has driven the Browns fast start
stories.summary: Columnist Terry Pluto credits first-year head coach Todd Monken and his emotional, detail-driven approach for the turnaround from a disastrous opener to 3-1 and first place in the AFC North. The revival of Deshaun Watson at quarterback has been central to it.

stories.title: Ryan Day previews Maryland after Buckeyes bounce back
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day met the media to review the 31-14 win over Iowa and turn attention to the home game against Maryland, where the fifth-ranked Buckeyes open as heavy favorites. Day said special teams remain the main area to fix.

stories.title: Ohio State basketball tip-off times and TV announced
stories.summary: The Big Ten released tip times and broadcast designations for the 2026-27 season, giving Ohio State 12 games on the Big Ten Network, six on FS1 and five on CBS, plus a Nov. 13 trip to UConn on TNT or HBO Max. The Buckeyes open with an exhibition against Cincinnati on Oct. 7.

stories.title: Russell to start Singapore Grand Prix from the back
stories.summary: Mercedes confirmed George Russell will take a power-unit penalty at the Singapore Grand Prix and start from the back of the grid after his engine failure at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia. Overtaking is notoriously difficult around Marina Bay.

stories.title: Mercedes confirm Russell engine penalty for Singapore
stories.summary: Mercedes has formally confirmed a fresh power unit and the resulting grid penalty for Russell, who retired in Malaysia. The change also reshuffles the team plan to introduce an upgraded engine later in the season.

stories.title: Russell penalty forces Mercedes engine plan rethink
stories.summary: Russell had hoped to delay the power-unit change until the United States Grand Prix so Mercedes could fit an upgraded engine under the ADUO rules, but the Sepang failure forced the swap in Singapore instead, GPFans reports. The penalty leaves him fighting through the field at Marina Bay.

stories.title: Tarkov 1.2.0.0 rewards veterans for helping new players
stories.summary: The 1.2.0.0 update for Escape from Tarkov is live, adding the EXFIL Brothers referral program that pays Operators and new Candidates for raiding together, a six-level Prestige system for the PvE Zone with permanent rewards, and a rework of PMC bot behavior and faction relations. Battlestate says further server synchronization work is coming.

stories.title: Columbus schools face health cost hike as trust frays
stories.summary: Teachers in Columbus City Schools will pay more for health insurance next year as the largest district in Ohio confronts a budget shortfall and rising healthcare costs. The Columbus Education Association has already taken a no-confidence vote in the board over its handling of the issue.

stories.title: Caleb Flynn sentenced to life without parole
stories.summary: A central Ohio man convicted of murdering his wife was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole, closing a case that drew statewide attention. Prosecutors described weeks of testimony about the killing.

stories.title: New ballistic evidence links three 2016 Columbus homicides
stories.summary: Columbus police said new ballistic analysis connects three unsolved 2016 homicide cases, reviving investigations that had gone cold. Investigators are asking the public for information as they re-examine the shootings.

stories.title: Teachers pack Columbus school board meeting over insurance
stories.summary: More than 100 union members packed the Columbus City Schools board meeting and heckled members as the board president rejected claims that officials mishandled the district insurance crisis. The district says a $40 million figure at the center of the dispute was an estimate, not money lost.
